_meta.join_rules: People keyed by exact email. Slack joined by the users.json email (Slack id kept). Gmail by mailbox/From address, GCal by calendar_id, Linear/Confluence/Drive by user email. GitHub logins attached only where entities.json joined them by exact_email. Trello is name-joined in entities.json, so it is shown under trello_informational and never used for status.
_meta.status_rule: status_at_clock from the latest AUTHORED record (Slack message, Gmail sent, Linear create/complete, GitHub commit/PR/review, Confluence edit/comment, Drive create/modify) before the clock: active_feb_2026 >= 2026-02-01; active_jan_2026_quiet_in_feb >= 2026-01-01; else quiet_since_<YYYY-MM>. Calendar attendance is not authored activity.
_meta.slack_hours: hours_utc are UTC hour histograms; every Slack profile says America/Los_Angeles, so use the GCal calendar_tz to localise.
limits: Slack messages with no email-bearing user (tokens such as EMPLOYEE_0024_SLACK_ID, PERSON_n) are under slack_only_ids, unjoined.
Gmail mailboxes named by tokens (EMPLOYEE_0011_EMAIL, SVC_0293_EMAIL ...) are not joined to anyone.
GitHub logins without an email join are listed under github_unjoined_logins (CodeRabbit, linear[bot], tokenised contributors).
Snowflake PAYROLL_ROSTER/HEADCOUNT use EMPLOYEE_n tokens + names; they are not joined here (see coherence_hazards for roster conflicts).

trello_informational.join_basis: entities.json exact_name (not email; excluded from status)
